channel.title: Boulder City Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Boulder City Review (bouldercityreview.com)

item.title: Defense leads way on gridiron
item.description: Boulder City High School flag football advanced to 7-7 on the season after splitting a pair of games this past week.

item.title: Eagles split a pair of games this week
item.description: Splitting a pair of league games this past week, Boulder City High School boys basketball sits in third place in the 3A league standings.

item.title: Lady Eagles drop a pair on the court
item.description: Currently sitting in fourth place in the 3A standings, Boulder City High School girls basketball dropped a pair of games this past week to Coral Academy and rival Virgin Valley.

item.title: Heavily redacted police report details lewd conduct allegations against former high school football coach
item.description: Frank Mariani, 46, was charged with three felony counts of lewdness committed by a person over 18 with a child 14 or 15 years of age and seven felony counts of child abuse or neglect.

item.title: Government Wash reopened for use
item.description: Popular spot was closed for 18 months

item.title: Woodbury honors Heart of the Community recipients
item.description: Last Saturday, some of our community’s most caring individuals were honored at Boulder City Hospital Foundation’s 14th annual Heart of the Community Gala, an event that raises essential funds to keep our non-profit Boulder City Hospital healthy and sustainable.

item.title: Hardy, Walton to seek reelection; filing begins March 2
item.description: Even though the closing date to run for Boulder City Council and mayor is still more than a month away, there will be familiar faces in the race.

item.title: Eight wrestlers qualify for state tournament
item.description: Putting in work at Virgin Valley on Feb. 7, eight Boulder City High School wrestlers punched their ticket to state, highlighted by regional champions Coen Burrows and Otis Ruth.

item.title: Lady Eagles to host playoff game
item.description: Finishing the regular season on a high note, Boulder City High School girls basketball won their last two regular-season games, earning the right to host a home playoff game.

item.title: Dynamic duo lead Eagles basketball into playoffs
item.description: Ending the regular season on a high note with a 17-10 record, Boulder City High School boys basketball won their final two regular-season games.
